current_disclosures.section: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements > Note 19: Commitments and Contingencies > Legal Proceedings > European Commission Competition Matter
current_disclosures.summary: In September 2023, the EC imposed a €376 million fine based on the 2009 finding that Intel made payments to prevent sales of specific rival products. Intel appealed, and in December 2025 the General Court reduced the fine to €237 million. Intel may appeal this decision to the Court of Justice, and the company has reduced its accrued charge for the fine to approximately $311 million as of December 27, 2025, while being unable to reasonably estimate any potential loss exceeding this amount.
